title: [Main][ALL-E] Report 713 "Inventory Custmer Sales" – Excel (data only) export generates one row per Item Ledger Entry with NULL values instead of one aggregated row per Item/Customer combinationInitial commit
summary: Report 713 now correctly exports aggregated rows per Item/Customer combination in Excel (data only) format instead of generating intermediate rows with NULL customer values.
key_points: The report was emitting dataset rows even when the temporary aggregate buffer was empty
Null customer values appeared in intermediate rows during Excel export
Solution adds CurrReport.Skip() to suppress intermediate rows while preserving aggregates and totals
Word layout and existing subtotals/grand totals remain unaffected
Test coverage added for the fix
quote: Excel (data only) export generates one row per Item Ledger Entry with NULL values instead of one aggregated row per Item/Customer combination
